title: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor faced £1.8m repair bill after leaving Royal Lodge
summary_full: Ex-prince was granted £302,000 in compensation for early end of lease and king has reportedly contributed to costsAndrew Mountbatten-Windsor faced a £1.8m bill to cover repair and restoration of his former Royal Lodge home in Windsor after the lease was officially surrendered.But the former prince was granted £302,000 in compensation for giving up the lease early on the 98-acre property, meaning his total costs came to £1.5m.
